name: Do shower grab bars come with a warranty?

mainEntity.name: Do shower grab bars come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: The warranty for shower grab bars typically depends on the manufacturer of the grab bar itself. Many reputable manufacturers offer warranties against defects in materials and workmanship. City Dweller, LLC, as your installer, provides a warranty on our installation labor. We ensure the grab bars are installed correctly and securely according to industry standards. Specific warranty details for both the product and our labor can be provided during your consultation and are included in your service agreement.
